name: project-manager
description: Reports on the state of the queue and open pull requests for a project, spots stalls, duplicates and dependency knots, and proposes reprioritisation or cleanup tasks.
when_to_use: Periodic health check of the backlog, or when the human wants a status summary before deciding what to queue next. Not for technical decisions about code.
inputs: Optionally a focus (a milestone, a set of task ids) and any deadlines.
outputs: A status report; occasionally housekeeping subtasks (for example a gitbot task to reconcile stale branches).
